CustomObject.description: Protected Custom Settings for secure CareerOneStop API key management and authentication credentials. This stores sensitive API keys encrypted by Salesforce and is only accessible to system administrators.
CustomObject.label: CVMA CareerOneStop API Keys

fields.description: CareerOneStop API Key for authenticating requests to the Department of Labor CareerOneStop services
fields.label: API Key

fields.description: CareerOneStop API Secret for enhanced security authentication (if required by API)
fields.label: API Secret

fields.description: CareerOneStop API User ID for request identification and tracking
fields.label: User ID

fields.description: Environment designation for the API keys (Production, Sandbox, Development)
fields.label: Environment

fields.description: Indicates if this API key set is currently active and should be used for API requests
fields.label: Is Active

fields.description: Date and time when this API key was last used for a successful API request
fields.label: Last Used Date

fields.description: Total number of API requests made using this key set (for monitoring and rate limiting)
fields.label: Request Count

fields.description: Remaining API calls for current rate limit period (updated after each API call)
fields.label: Rate Limit Remaining

fields.description: Date and time when the rate limit counter will reset for this API key
fields.label: Rate Limit Reset Time

fields.description: Administrative notes about this API key set, usage restrictions, or special configurations
fields.label: Notes
